1.consolidated_definition: Planta de hojas elegantes algo velludas, de diversos colores, generalmente rojas y verdes; es ornamental. Araceae, Caladium argyrites.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Elegant plant with slightly hairy leaves of various colors, typically red and green; it is ornamental. Family Araceae, Caladium argyrites.
